references.text: Abram was very rich in livestock, silver, and gold.
Consider how great Melchizedek was: Abraham, our ancestor, gave him a tenth of all the spoils he had won.
I will not take bulls from your house or goats from your flocks.
Elisha said, 'As surely as the Lord lives, whom I serve, I will accept nothing.' Even though Naaman tried to persuade him, he refused.
The Jews did not lay hands on the plunder, as an example of refusing enrichment from their enemies.
Both verses illustrate the principle of refusing material reward to ensure that the honor for the blessing is attributed to God alone.
